title: PCI-DSS Level 1 Compliance — Infrastructure Gaps
description:
Three critical PCI-DSS Level 1 gaps identified during compliance audit for the Payments feature (NEX-204):

1. Network segmentation: Payments service must be in a dedicated VPC subnet isolated from general application layer. Work tracked in NEX-218.
2. Audit logging: Card transaction audit logging not yet implemented. Tracked in NEX-219.
3. Penetration test: Third-party pen test required before certification. Vendor contracted, scheduled Nov 25 - Dec 6. Tracked in NEX-220.

Blocker for NEX-204. See email_02 for full findings and standup_03 for team discussion.
